mainTopic: A גט written for a יבמה, whether זיקה and מאמר are one tie, and קידושין after חליצה (רבי עקיבא, רבי and the חכמים)
overview: This amud opens by finishing a rule: a גט written for a woman with no tie to the man is worthless. Two questions follow, and both end in תיקו. רמי בר חמא asks whether a גט written for one's יבמה counts like one written for an ארוסה. רב חנניה asks whether a גט can cancel only the זיקה or only the מאמר, and a proof from רבא is turned away. Next, רב יהודה in the name of רב says the משנה's rule that nothing works after חליצה follows רבי עקיבא. The גמרא challenges this from the משנה's case of a גט followed by a מאמר. רב אשי answers that a גט to a יבמה forbids her only מדרבנן. ברייתות then show רבי's view: קידושין after חליצה work for ordinary marriage but not for the sake of יבום, while the חכמים say she needs a גט either way. רב יוסף, אביי and רבא each explain this argument differently, and רבא's explanation continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A divorce document for an unconnected woman is worthless
steps.stepSummary: The end of the earlier teaching: a גט written for a woman who has no tie to the man is not a valid גט, because he had no power to divorce her when it was written.
steps.simpleTranslation: But if he wrote it for an ordinary woman, it is not a valid גט, because he had no power to divorce her.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing a teaching from before: a גט only works if, when it was written, the man had some tie to the woman.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier cases (like an ארוסה) worked because she was already tied to him when the גט was written. A woman with no tie at all cannot be divorced, so a גט written for her is empty even if he marries her later. This sets up the next question: where does a יבמה fit?

keyTerms.meaning: Divorce document
An ordinary woman with no tie to him
He has no power to divorce her

phrases.english: But for an ordinary woman —
it is not a valid bill of divorce,
because it is not in his power to divorce her.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the teaching begun before this section.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A גט written for a woman he has no tie to is invalid, since he could not divorce her when it was written.

steps.title: Is a divorce document written for one's widowed sister-in-law valid?
steps.stepSummary: רמי בר חמא asks about a גט written for his יבמה: is she like an ארוסה because she is tied to him, or not, because he has not yet done מאמר?
steps.simpleTranslation: רמי בר חמא asked: if he wrote it for his יבמה, what is the law? Since she is tied to him, is she like his ארוסה? Or perhaps, since he has not done a מאמר with her, she is not?
steps.whatsHappening: רמי בר חמא asks whether a יבמה falls on the ארוסה side (a valid גט) or on the ordinary-woman side (no גט).
steps.deeperAnalysis: One side: the זיקה already ties her to him, so a גט written now has something to work on, like with an ארוסה. Other side: without a מאמר there is no betrothal at all, so she is not really like an ארוסה. The question is whether זיקה alone counts as a tie for writing a גט.

keyTerms.meaning: His יבמה, the widow of his brother who died with no children
She is tied to him
His betrothed (after קידושין, before נישואין)
A rabbinic betrothal the יבם does with the יבמה before יבום

phrases.english: Rami bar Chama asked:
If he wrote it for his yevama, what is the law?
phrases.notes: He wrote the גט first and gave it to her only after he married her.

phrases.english: Since she is tied to him —
she is like his betrothed,
or perhaps:
since he has not done levirate betrothal with her —
she is not like his betrothed?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the rule of step 1 to an in-between case.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does זיקה alone count as enough of a tie for a גט written beforehand to work, like with an ארוסה?

steps.title: The question stays unresolved
steps.stepSummary: רמי בר חמא's question is left open.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let it stand.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא has no answer, so it leaves the question open with תיקו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both sides of the question remain possible. Whether a גט written for a יבמה works stays undecided.

keyTerms.meaning: Let it stand: the question is left without an answer

phrases.english: Let it stand.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the question of step 2 without an answer.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: It is undecided whether a גט written for one's יבמה is valid.

steps.title: Can a divorce cancel just the bond or just the betrothal?
steps.stepSummary: רב חנניה asks: if a יבם who did מאמר writes a גט only for the זיקה, or only for the מאמר, does it work? Are they one connected tie, or two separate ties?
steps.simpleTranslation: רב חנניה asked: if he wrote a גט for his זיקה and not for his מאמר, or for his מאמר and not for his זיקה, what is the law? Does the מאמר sit on top of the זיקה, making him like someone who divorces half a woman, which does nothing? Or does each one stand on its own?
steps.whatsHappening: רב חנניה opens a new question about a יבם who has both a זיקה and a מאמר with the יבמה and tries to cancel only one of them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the מאמר is built on top of the זיקה, the two form one tie, and cancelling only part of it is like divorcing half a woman, which does nothing. If they are two separate ties, he can cancel either one alone. The question is whether זיקה and מאמר are one unit or two.

keyTerms.meaning: The automatic bond between the יבם and the יבמה
It is placed on top of
One who divorces half a woman
It stands on its own

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows the two layers of connection to a יבמה, the זיקה from the Torah and the מאמר added on top, and asks how they relate to each other.

phrases.english: Rav Chananya asked:
If he wrote a bill of divorce for his levirate bond
and not for his levirate betrothal,
or for his levirate betrothal and not for his levirate bond,
what is the law?
Is the levirate betrothal placed on top of the levirate bond,
so he is like one who divorces half a woman,
and one who divorces half a woman
has done nothing at all,
or perhaps:
this one stands on its own
and that one stands on its own.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new question, also about a גט given to a יבמה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Are זיקה and מאמר one combined tie (so a partial גט does nothing) or two separate ties (so each can be cancelled alone)?

steps.title: Trying to answer from רבא's ruling
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests answering רב חנניה from רבא, who said that a גט for the מאמר alone makes the co-wife permitted, which shows the מאמר can be cancelled separately.
steps.simpleTranslation: Why not resolve it from רבא? For רבא said: if he gave a גט for his מאמר, her צרה becomes permitted!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא suggests that רבא's ruling already answers רב חנניה's question.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא holds that a גט for the מאמר cancels just the מאמר, while the זיקה stays, so the צרה is still allowed to the יבם. That only makes sense if the מאמר stands on its own. So it seems to prove the 'each stands alone' side.

keyTerms.meaning: Resolve the question
She became permitted
Her צרה, the other widow of the same dead brother

phrases.english: But let him resolve it from Rava,
for Rava said:
If he gave a bill of divorce for his levirate betrothal —
her rival wife is permitted!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Tries to answer the question of step 4.
steps.raayaObject: רב חנניה's question: are זיקה and מאמר separate?
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבא: a גט for the מאמר makes the צרה permitted, so the מאמר can be cancelled by itself.

steps.title: רבא was sure, but רב חנניה was not
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that רבא held this was obvious, but רב חנניה himself was unsure, so רבא's view cannot settle his question.
steps.simpleTranslation: To רבא it was obvious; to רב חנניה it was a question.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא turns down the proof: רבא's ruling shows only what רבא thought, not what everyone must accept.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא simply took the 'separate ties' side for granted. רב חנניה was asking exactly this point and did not take it for granted. So רבא's ruling cannot answer him.

keyTerms.meaning: It is obvious to him
It is a question for him

phrases.english: To Rava it is obvious,
but to Rav Chananya it is a question,

steps.triggerLanguage: לְרָבָא פְּשִׁיטָא לֵיהּ לְרַב חֲנַנְיָה מִיבַּעְיָא לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the proof brought in step 5.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The proof from רבא as a way to answer רב חנניה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רבא assumed the very point רב חנניה was asking about, so his ruling is only his own opinion.

steps.title: רב חנניה's question stays open
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks what the law is and leaves it as תיקו.
steps.simpleTranslation: What is the law? Let it stand.
steps.whatsHappening: With רבא's proof turned down, there is no answer, so רב חנניה's question ends in תיקו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: It stays undecided whether a partial גט for only the זיקה or only the מאמר works. רבא's ruling stands as his own view, not as the settled answer.

keyTerms.meaning: What, then, is the law?

steps.whatToRemember: Both questions in this section, רמי בר חמא's about writing a גט for a יבמה and רב חנניה's about cancelling זיקה or מאמר alone, end in תיקו.

phrases.english: What is the law? Let it stand.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the question of step 4 after the proof was rejected.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: It is undecided whether a גט can cancel only the זיקה or only the מאמר.

steps.title: The rule that nothing works after חליצה follows רבי עקיבא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of a מאמר after חליצה. רב יהודה in the name of רב says the משנה's ruling (it does nothing) is רבי עקיבא's view, since he holds קידושין do not take hold with חייבי לאוין. The חכמים say something does take effect after חליצה.
steps.simpleTranslation: If he did חליצה and then did a מאמר: רב יהודה said in the name of רב: this is the view of רבי עקיבא, who says קידושין do not take hold with חייבי לאוין. But the חכמים say: something does take effect after חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to a new line of the משנה and explains whose opinion it follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After חליצה the woman is forbidden to the יבם by a לאו. רבי עקיבא holds that קידושין cannot take hold where a לאו forbids the couple, so the מאמר does nothing. The חכמים hold that קידושין do take hold despite a לאו, so a מאמר after חליצה does have some effect.

keyTerms.meaning: He did חליצה, the ceremony that frees the יבמה
Betrothal takes hold
Couples forbidden by a negative commandment (לאו)
Something takes effect after חליצה

steps.confusionAlert: The משנה's words 'nothing works after חליצה' are not everyone's view. רב says they follow רבי עקיבא alone, and the חכמים disagree.
steps.whyThisMatters: It ties the law of a מאמר after חליצה to the bigger question of whether קידושין take hold with חייבי לאוין.

phrases.english: If he performed chalitza and then did levirate betrothal.
phrases.notes: This is quoted from the משנה, which says such a מאמר does nothing.

phrases.english: Rav Yehuda said that Rav said:
This is the view of Rabbi Akiva,
who says: betrothal does not take hold
with those forbidden by a negative commandment.
But the Sages say:
something does take effect after chalitza.

steps.triggerLanguage: חָלַץ וְעָשָׂה מַאֲמָר אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב זוֹ דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic: a later line of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The משנה's rule that a מאמר after חליצה does nothing follows רבי עקיבא (קידושין do not take hold with חייבי לאוין); the חכמים hold that something does take effect after חליצה.

steps.title: Does the earlier case of the משנה fit רבי עקיבא?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges רב: the משנה's earlier case says a מאמר after a גט still needs a גט and חליצה, which seems impossible for רבי עקיבא.
steps.simpleTranslation: Can you really say the משנה follows רבי עקיבא? The earlier case says: if he gave a גט and then did מאמר, she needs a גט and חליצה. But for רבי עקיבא, once he gave her a גט, how could a מאמר work on her at all?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא attacks רב's claim from Step 8 that the משנה follows רבי עקיבא. It points to an earlier case in the same משנה that does not seem to fit him.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier case treats a מאמר given after a גט as real, since it needs its own גט to undo it. If רבי עקיבא holds that a גט makes the יבמה totally forbidden, a later מאמר should do nothing. So the same משנה cannot follow רבי עקיבא in both cases.

keyTerms.meaning: Can you really set it up as (following a certain view)?
The first or earlier clause of a משנה
Does it work? Does it take effect?

phrases.aramaic: וּמִי מָצֵית מוֹקְמַתְּ לַהּ כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא
phrases.english: And can you really set it up as following Rabbi Akiva?
But the first clause teaches:
If he gave a get and then did ma'amar,
she needs a get and chalitzah.
And if it follows Rabbi Akiva,
once he gave her a get,
does ma'amar take effect on her?

steps.triggerLanguage: וּמִי מָצֵית מוֹקְמַתְּ לַהּ כְּרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא, וְהָא קָתָנֵי רֵישָׁא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רב יהודה בשם רב's claim that the משנה follows רבי עקיבא.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב's claim that the משנה (מאמר after חליצה does nothing) follows רבי עקיבא.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The רישא treats a מאמר after a גט as effective. For רבי עקיבא, a גט forbids the יבמה to him forever (the ברייתא in the next step). He also holds that קידושין do not take hold where a לאו forbids the couple, so a later מאמר should not work. The משנה would then be inconsistent if it followed him.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא says a גט forbids the יבמה forever
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא proves that רבי עקיבא holds a גט makes the יבמה forbidden forever, learned from the פסוק אשר שלחה.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was taught: רבי עקיבא says, how do we know that one who gives a גט to his יבמה makes her forbidden to him forever? The פסוק says: 'Her first husband who sent her away may not...' This means that after sending her away, she is forbidden.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to prove the assumption behind its challenge. It shows that רבי עקיבא really holds a גט makes the יבמה forbidden forever.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא reads the words 'who sent her away' as making the sending itself (the גט) forbid her to him. If the גט creates a Torah איסור, a later מאמר should have no effect according to his own approach. This makes the challenge from Step 9 stronger.

keyTerms.meaning: His יבמה, his late brother's widow
Forever, permanently
Sending away, meaning divorce with a גט

phrases.english: But it was taught in a baraita: Rabbi Akiva says:
From where do we know that one who gives a get to his yevama
makes her forbidden to him forever?
As it says: 'Her first husband may not'
'who sent her away' (take her again).
After sending away, she is forbidden.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the source for the challenge in Step 9.
steps.raayaObject: That according to רבי עקיבא, a גט to a יבמה makes her forbidden forever, so a later מאמר could not take effect.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא quoting רבי עקיבא's reading of 'אשר שלחה' (דברים 24:4).

steps.title: The גט for a יבמה is only מדרבנן
steps.stepSummary: רב אשי answers: the גט for a יבמה works only מדרבנן, and the פסוק is just an אסמכתא. So the מאמר after it can still take hold.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אשי said: a גט given to a יבמה is only מדרבנן, and the פסוק is just a support.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אשי defends the idea that the משנה follows רבי עקיבא. He says the איסור caused by a גט to a יבמה is only מדרבנן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי עקיבא's rule that קידושין do not take hold applies to Torah-level איסורים. Since the איסור from a גט to a יבמה is only מדרבנן, the פסוק is just a hint, not a true source. The מאמר after the גט can therefore still take effect, even according to רבי עקיבא.

keyTerms.meaning: A גט given to a יבמה before יבום or חליצה
Rabbinic in force, not from the Torah
Merely a support or hint from a פסוק, not a real source

phrases.english: Rav Ashi said:
A get given to a yevama is only rabbinic,
and the verse is merely a support.
phrases.notes: He means the פסוק from the last step, 'who sent her away.'

steps.confusionAlert: רב אשי is not saying רבי עקיבא changed his view. He is saying the איסור from a גט to a יבמה was never a Torah איסור, so his rule about קידושין not taking hold does not apply to it.
steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי: גֵּט יְבָמִין מִדְּרַבָּנַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of Steps 9 and 10.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Downgrades the source: the איסור is only rabbinic, and the פסוק is merely an אסמכתא.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The גט creates a Torah איסור for רבי עקיבא, so a later מאמר could not take hold.
steps.terutzMaskana: The גט creates only a rabbinic איסור, so a later מאמר takes hold even for רבי עקיבא, and the משנה can follow him.

steps.title: A baraita supports רב יהודה's reading
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא from רבי supports רב יהודה: the ruling that nothing works after חליצה is רבי עקיבא's view, while the חכמים say something does take effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was also taught this way. רבי said: these words were said only according to רבי עקיבא, who treats a חלוצה like an ערוה. But the חכמים say something does take effect after חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא that says the same thing רב יהודה said in Step 8. This backs up his reading of the משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי, like רב, says the ruling that nothing takes effect after חליצה is רבי עקיבא's alone. רבי עקיבא treats a חלוצה like an ערוה, where קידושין never take hold. The חכמים disagree and hold that קידושין after חליצה do take effect.

keyTerms.meaning: It was also taught this way (a ברייתא that supports what was just said)
A woman who had חליצה done
A woman forbidden as a forbidden relation, with whom קידושין cannot take hold
Anything, something

phrases.english: It was also taught this way: Rabbi said:
phrases.notes: This backs up רב יהודה's statement from before the challenge, not רב אשי's answer.

phrases.english: These words were not said
except according to Rabbi Akiva,
who would treat a woman after chalitzah like a forbidden relation.
But the Sages say:
Something does take effect after chalitzah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Goes back to רב יהודה's statement in Step 8 and supports it with a ברייתא.
steps.raayaObject: רב יהודה בשם רב's claim that the משנה's ruling follows רבי עקיבא, while the חכמים say something takes effect after חליצה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא in which רבי states the same thing.

steps.title: רבי's distinction: betrothal for marriage versus for יבום
steps.stepSummary: רבי adds his own view: קידושין after חליצה work only when done for ordinary marriage. If done for the sake of יבום, nothing takes effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: And I say: when does something take effect? When he gave her קידושין for ordinary marriage. But if he gave her קידושין for the sake of יבום, nothing takes effect after חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי gives his own view, which limits what the חכמים said. He says it depends on why the man gave the קידושין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After חליצה, the יבום bond is fully gone, so trying to do יבום (a מאמר) has nothing left to work on. But ordinary קידושין, like for any other woman, can still take hold. This is because for the חכמים she is only forbidden by a לאו, not like an ערוה.

keyTerms.meaning: When? In which case?
For the sake of ordinary marriage
For the sake of יבום

steps.whatToRemember: For רבי עקיבא, nothing works after חליצה because a חלוצה is like an ערוה. For the חכמים, something does work. רבי adds that this is only ordinary קידושין, not קידושין meant as יבום.

phrases.english: And I say: when is this so?
phrases.notes: 'I' is רבי, giving his own view on what the חכמים said.

phrases.english: When he gave her kiddushin for the sake of ordinary marriage,
but if he gave her kiddushin for the sake of yibum,
nothing takes effect after chalitzah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Limits the חכמים' view quoted in Step 12.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי's own view ("ואני אומר"): קידושין after חליצה take effect only when done for ordinary marriage. Done for the sake of יבום, nothing takes effect after חליצה. The next ברייתא shows that the חכמים disagree with this distinction.

steps.title: Another ברייתא: רבי and the חכמים argue about קידושין after חליצה
steps.stepSummary: A second ברייתא says that רבי requires a גט only if the קידושין were for regular marriage, while the חכמים require a גט either way.
steps.simpleTranslation: Another ברייתא teaches: if a man does חליצה with his יבמה and then gives her קידושין, רבי says: if he did it for regular marriage, she needs a גט from him; if he did it for the sake of יבום, she does not need a גט. The חכמים say: either way, she needs a גט from him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא on the same topic as step 13. Here we see that the חכמים disagree with רבי's distinction.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 13 we heard only רבי's view. This ברייתא adds that the חכמים say קידושין after חליצה always work, even if they were done for the sake of יבום. That sets up the question of why רבי makes this distinction at all.

keyTerms.meaning: For the sake of regular marriage
For the sake of יבום
One who does חליצה

phrases.english: It is taught in another ברייתא:
One who does חליצה with his יבמה and then betroths her,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי אוֹמֵר: אִם קִדְּשָׁהּ לְשׁוּם אִישׁוּת —
phrases.english: רבי says: if he betrothed her for regular marriage —
she needs a גט from him;

phrases.aramaic: לְשׁוּם יַבְמוּת — אֵין צְרִיכָה הֵימֶנּוּ גֵּט.
phrases.english: for the sake of יבום — she does not need a גט from him.

phrases.aramaic: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: בֵּין שֶׁקִּדְּשָׁהּ לְשׁוּם אִישׁוּת,
phrases.english: And the חכמים say: whether he betrothed her for regular marriage,
or he betrothed her for the sake of יבום —
she needs a גט from him.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Shows the full מחלוקת behind רבי's view from step 13, with the חכמים disagreeing.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי: קידושין after חליצה for the sake of יבום need no גט; חכמים: a גט is needed in every case.

steps.title: רב יוסף explains רבי's reason with the case of hoeing a convert's land
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף says רבי compares this to someone who hoes an ownerless convert's land while thinking it is his own, so he does not acquire it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב יוסף said: What is רבי's reason? They treated it like someone who hoes the land of a convert, thinking it is his own land, who does not acquire it.
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף asks and answers why רבי says קידושין for the sake of יבום do not work after חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Hoeing ownerless land normally acquires it, but only if you mean to acquire it. Someone who thinks the land is already his has no intent to acquire, so he gets nothing. In the same way, the יבם thought he was doing יבום, and since the יבום bond is gone, his act does nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: One who hoes or digs the ground
The property of a convert (who died without heirs)
And he thinks they are his own
Acquires

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב יוֹסֵף: מַאי טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי —
phrases.english: רב יוסף said: What is the reason of רבי?
They made it like one who hoes the property of a convert
phrases.notes: The גמרא assumes the convert died with no heirs, so his land has no owner and anyone can acquire it by working it.

phrases.english: and thinks it is his own, who does not acquire it.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב יוֹסֵף: מַאי טַעְמָא דְּרַבִּי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a reason for רבי's position in the ברייתא.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why רבי says קידושין for the sake of יבום after חליצה do not work.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Without the right intent to acquire, the act does not acquire, like hoeing a convert's land while thinking it is your own.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי's reason: an act done with the wrong intent does not acquire. This is like hoeing a convert's ownerless land while thinking it is your own.

steps.title: אביי rejects רב יוסף's comparison
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the cases are different: the hoer had no intent to acquire, but the יבם does want to acquire the woman. A better comparison is mistaking one convert's land for another's, where he does acquire.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said to him: Are they really alike? There, he does not mean to acquire. Here, he does mean to acquire! This is only like someone who hoes the land of this convert thinking it belongs to a different convert, where he does acquire.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי attacks רב יוסף's explanation by showing that the comparison does not fit.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The man who thinks the land is his own is not trying to acquire anything. The יבם is trying to marry the woman; he is only mistaken about the reason. A mistake about the reason is like mixing up which convert owned the land, and in that case the acquisition does work. So by רב יוסף's own comparison, the קידושין should work.

keyTerms.meaning: Are they alike? (the cases are not comparable)
Intends to acquire
A different convert

phrases.english: אביי said to him: Are they alike?
There, he does not intend to acquire;
here, he does intend to acquire!
phrases.notes: "Here" means the יבם, who really does want to take the woman as his wife.

phrases.english: This is only similar
to one who hoes the property of this convert

phrases.aramaic: וּכְסָבוּר שֶׁל גֵּר אַחֵר הוּא, דְּקָנֵי.
phrases.english: and thinks it belongs to a different convert, who does acquire.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges רב יוסף's explanation from step 15.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב יוסף's comparison of the יבם to one who hoes a convert's land thinking it is his own.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The יבם does intend to acquire and is only wrong about the reason. That is like mixing up two converts' land, where acquisition works, so the קידושין should work too.

steps.title: אביי's new explanation: the case is מאמר יבמין, which rests on the זיקה
steps.stepSummary: אביי says the case is where the יבם said 'be betrothed to me with מאמר יבמין.' רבי holds that מאמר rests on the זיקה, and חליצה has removed the זיקה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, אביי said: What case are we dealing with here? Where he said to her, 'Be betrothed to me with מאמר יבמין.' רבי holds that מאמר is placed on top of the זיקה, and חליצה came and cancelled the זיקה.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי drops רב יוסף's approach and explains the מחלוקת in a new way, starting with רבי's side.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now the issue is not intent. The יבם used the special wording of מאמר יבמין. For רבי, a מאמר only builds on an existing זיקה. After חליצה there is no זיקה, so the מאמר has nothing to rest on and does nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: What case are we dealing with here?
קידושין given by a יבם to a יבמה
The bond tying the יבמה to the יבם
Is placed on top of
Cancelled it, removed it

phrases.english: Rather, אביי said:
With what case are we dealing here?
For example, where he said to her:
Be betrothed to me with מאמר יבמין.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי סָבַר: מַאֲמָר עִילָּוֵי זִיקָה קָא רָמֵי,
phrases.english: רבי holds: מאמר is placed on top of the זיקה,
and חליצה came and cancelled her זיקה.

steps.triggerLanguage: אֶלָּא אָמַר אַבָּיֵי: הָכָא בְּמַאי עָסְקִינַן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Replaces רב יוסף's rejected explanation with a new reading of the case.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the case (אוקימתא) to the wording of מאמר יבמין
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבי's view was about the יבם's intention, like the hoeing case.
steps.terutzMaskana: רבי's view is about מאמר יבמין, which depends on the זיקה and fails once חליצה removes it.
steps.confusionAlert: אביי is not saying the יבם lacked intent. He is saying the wording he used, מאמר יבמין, needs a זיקה to work, and after חליצה there is none.

steps.title: The חכמים's side: the מאמר stands on its own
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים hold that the זיקה and the מאמר are separate. Just as מאמר יבמין works before חליצה, it still works after.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the רבנן hold: this one stands by itself and that one stands by itself. At the start, if he had said to her 'be betrothed to me with מאמר יבמין,' would it not have worked? Now too it works.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי finishes his explanation by giving the חכמים's reasoning, which disagrees with רבי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the חכמים, the מאמר does not depend on the זיקה; it works like regular קידושין. If it worked before חליצה, removing the זיקה does not stop it from working afterward. So she needs a גט either way.

keyTerms.meaning: Stands by itself, is independent
At the start (before חליצה)
It works, takes effect
Now too

steps.whatToRemember: According to אביי, רבי and the חכמים argue about מאמר יבמין after חליצה. רבי says the מאמר rests on the זיקה, so it fails once the זיקה is gone. The חכמים say the מאמר is independent, so it still works and she needs a גט.

phrases.english: And the רבנן hold:

phrases.aramaic: הַאי לְחוֹדֵיהּ קָאֵי וְהַאי לְחוֹדֵיהּ קָאֵי.
phrases.english: This stands by itself, and that stands by itself.
phrases.notes: One "this" is the זיקה and the other is the מאמר. They are two separate things.

phrases.english: At the start, if he had said to her,
"Be betrothed to me with מאמר יבמין,"
would it not have worked?
Now too it works.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרַבָּנַן סָבְרִי: הַאי לְחוֹדֵיהּ קָאֵי וְהַאי לְחוֹדֵיהּ קָאֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes אביי's explanation by giving the חכמים's side of the מחלוקת.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Explaining the opposing view within the same אוקימתא
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Perhaps everyone agrees that מאמר יבמין needs a זיקה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The חכמים treat the מאמר as independent of the זיקה, so it works even after חליצה.

steps.title: רבא: With the words of levirate betrothal, everyone agrees it works
steps.stepSummary: רבא disagrees with אביי's case. He says that if the יבם said 'with מאמר יבמין,' both רבי and the חכמים agree the קידושין take effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבא said: If he said to her, 'Be betrothed to me with levirate betrothal,' everyone agrees that it works.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא begins a new way of explaining the argument. First he removes אביי's case from the dispute: when the יבם said 'with מאמר יבמין,' nobody argues.
steps.deeperAnalysis: אביי said the argument is exactly in the case of 'מאמר יבמין.' רבא says no: in that case everyone agrees the betrothal is effective. So the argument must be about a different wording, which he gives next.

keyTerms.meaning: Levirate betrothal: a betrothal a יבם gives his יבמה before יבום
Everyone agrees; nobody argues
It works; it takes effect

phrases.english: Rava said:
If he said to her: Be betrothed to me 'with levirate betrothal,'
everyone agrees that it is effective.

steps.triggerLanguage: רָבָא אָמַר: אִי דְּאָמַר לַהּ ״בְּמַאֲמַר יְבָמִין״, כּוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers a different explanation from אביי's in steps 17-18, starting by removing his case from the dispute.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Redefining the case of the dispute
steps.terutzHavaAmina: אביי held the dispute was when the יבם said 'with מאמר יבמין.'
steps.terutzMaskana: In the case of 'with מאמר יבמין,' everyone agrees the betrothal works.

steps.title: רבא: The argument is when he said 'with the levirate bond'
steps.stepSummary: רבא sets the case of the argument: the יבם said 'be betrothed to me with זיקת יבמין.' He then starts to give רבי's reasoning.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what case are we dealing with here? Where he said to her, 'Be betrothed to me with the levirate bond.' רבי holds:
steps.whatsHappening: רבא now gives his own case for the argument between רבי and the חכמים. The line 'רבי holds' sets up the explanation of each side, which continues on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The difference is the wording. Here the יבם tried to betroth her through the זיקה, the bond between them. Since חליצה already cut that bond, the question is whether his words can still mean anything. The reasons of רבי and the חכמים come next.

keyTerms.meaning: What case are we dealing with here? (used to narrow down the exact case)
The levirate bond: the connection between the יבם and the יבמה
Be betrothed to me
Holds; is of the opinion

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up the two wordings. 'מאמר יבמין' (levirate betrothal) is what everyone agrees works. 'זיקת יבמין' (the levirate bond) is the wording they argue about.

phrases.english: And with what are we dealing here?
For example, where he said to her:
'Be betrothed to me with the levirate bond.'
Rabbi holds:
phrases.notes: The sentence stops here. רבי's reasoning continues on the next amud.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָכָא בְּמַאי עָסְקִינַן — כְּגוֹן דְּאָמַר לַהּ ״הִתְקַדְּשִׁי לִי בְּזִיקַּת יְבָמִין״
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After removing אביי's case, רבא gives the case that he says the argument is about, and begins explaining רבי's view.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The dispute could have been about the 'מאמר יבמין' wording.
steps.terutzMaskana: The dispute is about the wording 'זיקת יבמין.' The reasoning of each side continues next.
